core_categories: Retail Pharmacy; Prescription Drugs; Health & Wellness Products; Personal Care
specialty_focus: Guardian Pharmacy operates as a retail pharmacy network, offering prescription drugs, health essentials, and wellness products through physical stores and online platforms. It serves as a community partner for everyday medical and personal care needs. In the U.S., Guardian Pharmacy Services specializes in long-term care pharmacy, providing medication management solutions for assisted living, memory care, and behavioral health facilities. It does not specifically focus on wearable medical devices.
